name: ABB Reset PP
description: Reset the RAPID program pointer to main on an ABB controller once per button press. Calls resetpp only on the rising edge of the arm button, so a held or recomputed True never re-resets the pointer.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: RWS session from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected resets nothing and yields no error.

inputParameters.name: arm
inputParameters.description: Connect a Button; a True fires the reset once. A held or recomputed True never re-resets the program pointer.

outputParameters.name: status
outputParameters.description: Short status string of the reset that just fired. Empty until the next press.
